# Matthew Park

> Matthew Park is a teenage founder from Kentucky. He is building Nudgy, an iPhone assistant, and Axiom Pathways, a nonprofit that helps young people land internships at startups. This site is a one-page portfolio.

## Building
- [Nudgy](https://nudgy.run): an iPhone assistant that listens to your day and quietly does the next thing. Invite-only, free during the beta.
- [Axiom Pathways](https://axiompathways.org): a nonprofit that helps young people (high school and college) land real internships at startups. 800+ interns and 10+ startups so far; the goal is millions.

## Pages
- [Home](https://matthewnpark.com/): the whole site, on one page
